description: A one-on-one fighter pitting iconic super-robot anime mecha against each other, each with signature attacks straight from the shows.

title: Eikou no Saint Andrews
description: Japan-only golf on the legendary Old Course at St Andrews. Pick from named pros with their own strengths, unlock clubs and gear, and compete across stroke, match and tournament play for the title.

title: Rocket: Robot on Wheels
description: Rocket the amusement-park robot uses a tractor beam and booster rockets to foil the jealous mascot Jojo's takeover. Grab, build and physics-puzzle across the park in a clever, underrated platformer.

title: Space Station Silicon Valley
description: Hijack the bodies of malfunctioning robot animals - each with unique abilities - to puzzle and platform across a runaway space station. An inventive curio from the makers of GTA.

title: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire
description: Fight the Empire as mercenary Dash Rendar, from the Hoth speeder battle to swoop-bike chases and the criminal underworld. On foot and in vehicles, across the famous 'lost chapter' of the trilogy.

title: Supercross 2000
description: Whip over jumps and battle for the holeshot across indoor stadium tracks, racing a full season of arena motocross.

title: Scooby-Doo! Classic Creep Capers
description: Help Scooby and the gang unmask the Witch Doctor, Black Knight and Snow Ghost. Sneak past spooks, gather clues, and spend Scooby Snacks to crack four classic-cartoon mysteries.

title: NFL Blitz Special Edition
description: No-rules arcade football with bigger hits and on-fire streaks. Seven-on-seven mayhem with late hits and turbo, expanded here with new plays and teams.

title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
description: The Dinosaur Hunter returns to battle an alien evil across vast jungles, packing a savage arsenal led by the legendary, screen-clearing Cerebral Bore. Explore six huge worlds and gather the energy totems.

title: Shin Nihon Pro Wrestling Toukon Road 2: The Next Generation
description: New Japan Pro Wrestling brings the burning fighting spirit to the ring. Legends and hungry young lions fire up for your greatest challenge yet - grapple your way to the top.

title: CyberTiger
description: Tee off with Tiger Woods in lighthearted arcade golf on fantastical island courses. Pick a colourful pro and chip across whimsical tropics in breezy four-player play.

title: Tetris 64
description: The block-stacking classic, plus a Bio Tetris mode that speeds up or slows down in time with your pulse, via a bundled ear sensor. Yes, really.

title: Tigger's Honey Hunt
description: Bounce, glide and stomp through the Hundred Acre Wood as Tigger, hunting honeypots to help Pooh and friends.

title: Disney's Tarzan
description: Swing through the jungle as Tarzan to save your ape family. Ride boars, surf the trees and vine-swing across levels lifted from the Disney film, gathering letters and tokens.

title: Transformers: Beast Wars Metals 64
description: Command the heroic Maximals or the evil Predacons in their war for supremacy. Convert between beast, vehicle and robot modes, blasting your way to victory with the mighty Ultra Blast.

title: 64 Trump Collection: Alice no Waku Waku Trump World
description: An Alice-in-Wonderland-themed pack of classic card games. Whimsical Wonderland hosts run poker, blackjack, solitaire and more in a cheerful package made for casual play.

title: O.D.T.
description: Marooned aboard a doomed airship in a hostile world, four survivors fight for a way home - mixing gunplay, melee and arcane magic across brooding 3D battlegrounds. Escape, or die trying.

title: 1080 Snowboarding
description: Carve down mountains and nail tricks in Nintendo's pioneering snowboarder, built on slick, weighty physics. Pick a rider and board, then ride race, trick and half-pipe modes across eight courses.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater
description: Skate a roster of real pros, stringing combos and grinding rails across iconic parks against the clock. Hit gaps, chase high scores, and unlock pros, tapes and decks - the one that started the craze.

title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue
description: Help Buzz rescue Woody from greedy collector Al. Sprint, spin and laser-blast through 3D levels packed with Pixar characters and collectibles.

title: WWF Attitude
description: Create a superstar and brawl through the Attitude Era with a deep WWF roster. Climb a career storyline through dozens of match types, building your dream grappler in a deep create suite.

title: Tom and Jerry in Fists of Furry
description: The cat-and-mouse rivalry erupts into a frantic 3D brawler. Bash your foe with mallets, fish and frying pans across cartoon arenas, solo or in multiplayer.

title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
description: Choose one of two heroes and battle the forces of Oblivion in a darker, story-driven Turok. Switch between Joseph and Danielle, each with unique gear, across a cinematic dino-blasting campaign.

title: Mischief Makers
description: Grab, shake and throw everything in sight as the robot maid Marina in Treasure's frantic side-scroller. Shake enemies and objects loose to solve puzzles - 'Shake, shake!' - across a delightfully odd adventure.

title: All Star Tennis '99
description: Serve and volley through arcade tennis with a colourful cast. Rally across singles, doubles and tournaments with simple controls and pacey play.

title: Shin Nihon Pro Wrestling Toukon Road: Brave Spirits
description: Step into the ring with New Japan Pro Wrestling's bravest fighting souls and climb to the top. Slick 3D and an intuitive control system bring the burning-spirit grappling to life.

title: Tetrisphere
description: Peel layers of blocks off a sphere in a hypnotic twist on falling-block puzzles. Slide and drop pieces to expose the core, racing puzzle and time-attack modes to a thumping techno beat.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
description: Chain tricks with the new manual, cash in your scores for stats and gear, and skate the world's top pros across pro parks. Career and free-skate, sharper than ever.

title: Top Gear Rally
description: Race rally cars across high-speed on- and off-road tracks with shifting weather and shortcuts. Win Championship mode to unlock faster cars, and paint your own schemes - solo or split-screen.

title: Centre Court Tennis
description: Pick-up-and-play arcade tennis on grass, clay and hard courts. Rally through quick exhibitions and a climb to the title, with snappy doubles play.

title: Tonic Trouble
description: Lanky alien Ed is sent down to clean up the chaos after he drops a dangerous can on Earth. Platform across worlds twisted by the alien tonic, setting things right in a colourful 3D adventure.

title: Turok: Dinosaur Hunter
description: Hunt through a Lost Land of dinosaurs and aliens, packing a savage arsenal in this pioneering N64 shooter. Explore eight sprawling levels for keys and weapons, up to the screen-clearing Chronoscepter.

title: Tonic Trouble
description: Help clumsy alien Ed recover a reality-warping can and undo the chaos it caused, platforming through a colourful 3D world bent out of shape by its power.

title: 64 de Hakken!! Tamagotchi: Minna de Tamagotchi World
description: A Japan-only Mario Party-style board game. Care for your Tamagotchi each turn and play minigames against rivals; the winner's character evolves into one of 59 game-exclusive forms. An early forerunner of Tamagotchi: Party On!.

title: Looney Tunes: Taz Express
description: Spin into action as the Tasmanian Devil, devouring everything in your path across madcap platforming stages on a hungry trek home.

title: Turok 2: Seeds of Evil
description: With the Campaigner beaten, an even deadlier foe - the Primagen - waits to break free from a buried craft at the Lost Land's core. Once more a Turok must restore peace and stop the worlds from merging.

title: PD Ultraman Battle Collection 64
description: An RPG built around the hero Ultraman, and one of the few N64 games to use the Transfer Pak: connect any Game Boy game to generate a character from its save data, Monster Rancher-style.

title: Nushi Zuri 64: Shiokaze ni Notte
description: A sea-set entry in the Nushi Tsuri fishing-RPG line (Japan only). Roam towns, buy tackle and fish the right spots, raising your catch in a tank. Random encounters let you flee or fight; transfers data from the Game Boy Color game.

title: Nushi Zuri 64
description: The first N64 entry in the fishing RPG line (Japan only). Roam towns, talk to NPCs, buy tackle, then find a spot to fish and raise your catch in a tank. Random encounters let you scare enemies off, dash to safety - or take a beating.

title: Chameleon Twist 2
description: Sunsoft's direct sequel. When the rabbit returns and knocks a chameleon skyward, it transforms into a humanoid hero who must gather six carrots across six worlds - Ice, Carnival, Sky and more - using that ever-useful grabbing, swinging tongue.

title: Micro Machines 64 Turbo
description: Race tiny toy cars across breakfast tables and pool tables in frantic top-down mayhem. Knock rivals clean off-screen in pacey races for up to eight players.

title: Vigilante 8
description: Battle a roster of armed vehicles across open arenas in a groovy 1970s car-combat blast. Story, arcade and split-screen, soaked in funk and fireballs.

title: Bass Rush: ECOGEAR PowerWorm Championship
description: Competitive bass fishing built around real ECOGEAR tackle - from the cast to the catch, across tournaments on varied waters.

title: Virtual Chess 64
description: Sharpen your game against a strong chess engine. Adjustable difficulty, built-in tutorials, hints and puzzles for players of every level.

title: Vigilante 8: 2nd Offense
description: More vehicular carnage: new rides, gnarlier weapons and destructible arenas. Wage 1970s car-combat war across story, arcade and multiplayer.

title: V-Rally Edition '99
description: Slide through rally stages across changing surfaces and weather in a deep, demanding racer. Master throttle and handbrake through an unforgiving championship and time trials.

title: Virtual Pro Wrestling 64
description: AKI's celebrated grappling engine with a deep counter system and a roster of Japanese wrestling stars. Counter and chain holds in the engine that underpinned the West's WWF and WCW games.

title: Virtual Pool 64
description: Line up your shot in a realistic pool sim. Sink true-physics racks of eight-ball, nine-ball and trick shots, with a free-aim cue for genuine table feel.

title: Space Station Silicon Valley
description: Body-swap into robotic animals, each with unique skills, to puzzle and platform across a wildlife-run space station. An inventive curio from the team that went on to make GTA.

title: V-Rally Edition 99
description: Rally across 40-plus tracks and eight world locations in 11 official WRC cars. Tackle jungle, canyon, desert and mountain through rain, fog and snow, tuning your setup to the road - with hidden cars and tracks to unlock.

title: WCW/nWo Revenge
description: Grapple a stacked roster of WCW and nWo stars in AKI's celebrated engine - the sequel that perfected N64 wrestling.

title: WCW Nitro
description: Step into the ring with WCW's roster in a fast arcade wrestler based on Monday Nitro. Quick controls, big moves, and a stable of hidden wrestlers to unlock.

title: WWF: No Mercy
description: The pinnacle of N64 wrestling. A huge WWF roster, a deep create-a-wrestler, and a sprawling story mode where you manage the titles - in the AKI engine many still call the best wrestling game ever made.

title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey '98
description: Fast arcade hockey with NHL rosters, big checks and the Great One on the marquee. Refreshed rosters, smoother skating and one-timers headline the sequel.

title: War Gods
description: Ten ancient warriors, juiced up by a cosmic ore, clash in a 3D weapons fighter. Dial up brutal combos, fatalities and special moves across the roster.

title: Iggy's Reckin' Balls
description: Climb tangled towers and race rivals up a knot of tracks, swinging and bashing them off as you go. A frantic vertical scramble for up to four.

title: Wild Choppers
description: A Japan-only helicopter action game: pilot attack choppers through aerial combat and rescue missions, strafing ground and air targets across varied terrain, solo or in versus.

title: WinBack: Covert Operations
description: Take cover and lean out to shoot as an agent storming a terrorist-held base. A pioneering stop-and-pop shooter - duck, peek, fire, repeat - clearing rooms one by one.

title: Wheel of Fortune
description: Spin the wheel, buy your vowels and solve the puzzle in the N64 take on the classic game show. Spin for cash and crack the board against rivals.

title: Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey
description: Fast, accessible arcade hockey with NHL teams and the Great One headlining. Built on big hits and end-to-end rushes.

title: ECW Hardcore Revolution
description: Extreme Championship Wrestling comes to life with weapons and hardcore matches. Swing chairs and ladders through brutal bouts, with a full ECW roster and a deep create-a-wrestler.

title: Telefoot Soccer 2000
description: Allez les Bleus! Officially backed by Telefoot and the French Football Federation, take 24 national sides from kick-off to the final whistle in fast, fully-licensed arcade football.

title: Waialae Country Club: True Golf Classics
description: Read the wind and Bermuda greens of the famed Sony Open venue in Hawaii. Six modes and custom club bags across stroke, match and tournament play, with a smooth swing meter.

title: WCW Mayhem
description: Take the fight backstage and into the crowd across a huge WCW roster. Brawl through a season-spanning Quest for the Best, with a deep career mode.

title: WCW vs. nWo: World Tour
description: The title that launched N64 wrestling. AKI's pioneering engine let holds flow seamlessly; fight World Tour mode against the nWo and unearth hidden legends.

title: World Driver Championship
description: Build and tune a stable of GT supercars, then qualify and race across lavish global circuits in a graphically striking championship racer.

title: Wipeout 64
description: The biggest name in anti-gravity racing lands on N64 with blistering speed, time trials and weapons. Master the air brakes and speed classes across weapon-strewn circuits, solo or split-screen.

title: Rally Challenge 2000
description: Race nine authentic WRC cars across scorching global rally stages. Attack point-to-point specials over gravel, tarmac and snow, trimming tenths through a globe-trotting championship.

title: Wave Race 64
description: The water is the real opponent - a living swell that heaves your jet ski around every buoy. Lean into the wake, hug the inside of each marker, and learn the sea's moods across championship and stunt runs. Still one of the best-feeling water sims ever made.

title: International Superstar Soccer '98
description: Konami's acclaimed football for the World Cup year: tight controls, real tactics and national squads. Play through friendlies, leagues and a world-cup run.

title: Wetrix
description: Wall in falling raindrops to build lakes for points - but mind the floods, fireballs and earthquakes. A genuinely original puzzler with a learning curve all its own.

title: Worms Armageddon
description: Turn-based artillery with a cartoon body count. Deploy bazookas, grenades and the legendary exploding sheep across destructible terrain, with deep options and chaotic multiplayer.

title: WCW Backstage Assault
description: An all-brawling WCW game fought entirely backstage. Battle through weapon-littered locales with brawler-style combat and a deep create-a-wrestler - no ring in sight.

title: WWF War Zone
description: WWF wrestling with a big late-90s Attitude Era roster. Battle through Challenge and career modes chaining combos, reversals and finishers, or build your own grappler in a deep create suite.

title: WWF WrestleMania 2000
description: Powered by the AKI engine: a huge WWF roster, deep create tools, and a sprawling Road to WrestleMania career. Grapple, reverse and chase every belt.

title: NBA In The Zone 2000
description: Konami's run-and-gun NBA returns with full rosters and smooth, arcade-paced play. Throw down flashy dunks and alley-oops with refined controls and a full season to chase.

title: Gex 64: Enter the Gecko
description: The wisecracking gecko leaps into 3D, platforming through TV-themed worlds with a quip for every channel. Collect remotes across Horror, Kung-Fu, Toon and Jungle channels.

title: Gex 3: Deep Cover Gecko
description: Gex zaps back into the airwaves for a 3D platforming romp across TV-genre parodies. Snag remotes and free fellow agents through Horror, Kung-Fu, Cartoon and Cowboy channels, quipping all the way.

title: WWF No Mercy
description: AKI's celebrated wrestling sim and the studio's N64 finale. A huge WWF roster, deep create-a-wrestler, and a sprawling story mode across the title belts - with the smooth grapple system that made it the era's definitive wrestler.

title: Xena: Warrior Princess
description: Fight as the warrior princess across mythic battlegrounds. Wield sword, chakram and martial-arts combos against warlords and monsters.

title: NBA Hang Time
description: Two-on-two arcade hoops with monster dunks, create-a-player and the on-fire streaks of the Jam tradition. Build a custom baller and let the gravity-defying jams fly.

title: Cruis'n Exotica
description: Boost through prehistoric jungles, alien worlds and the ocean floor, pulling midair tricks in arcade racing for show-offs. The wildest stop on the Cruis'n tour.

title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
description: Rayman fights to free his world from robot pirates in a celebrated 3D platformer. Glide, climb and fire energy fists across painterly worlds to topple Admiral Razorbeard and free the captive Teensies.

title: Yakouchuu II: Satsujin Kouro
description: Sequel to the SNES text-adventure mystery, this one set at sea. After a ship is attacked, you must piece together what happened - a Japan-only whodunit of careful reading and deduction.

title: Paperboy
description: The arcade classic returns in 3D. Pedal the suburbs delivering papers and dodging mowers, dogs, tornadoes and the supernatural across a week of escalating routes.

title: Yoshi's Story
description: Guide the baby Yoshis through a storybook world of papercraft and crayon. Gobble fruit to stay happy and chase the Super Happy Tree, picking your own path through hand-crafted pages.

title: Harvest Moon 64
description: Inherit a run-down farm and build a life. Grow crops and raise animals through the seasons, befriend the townsfolk, court a partner, and turn the family plot back into a home.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: A forest boy draws a sword from its pedestal and wakes seven years later as Hyrule's last hope. Z-target your foes, play the ocarina to bend time and weather, raise allies and ride Epona toward Ganondorf - the game that taught 3D action how to feel.

title: Battlezone: Rise of the Black Dogs
description: Command a tank in first-person across an alternate-history Cold War, blending shooting with battlefield strategy. Build bases and harvest resources from the cockpit while the armour duels rage.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: Trapped in a three-day loop beneath a falling moon, Link must master time and a wardrobe of magic masks to save Termina. Replay the same fateful three days, wielding the Song of Time, to stop the sky from landing.
